name: synth
style: 1980s synthwave retro-futurism: glowing magenta and cyan neon, a chrome horizon, an endless laser grid floor, a huge striped sunset sun, palm silhouettes, scan lines and soft VHS bloom, smooth gliding motion.
picture_style: Style: 1980s synthwave retro-futurist illustration, glowing magenta and cyan neon, laser grid, chrome highlights, soft VHS bloom and scan lines.
voice: A man with a smooth, low, late-night radio voice

speaker.draw: An ordinary realistic studio product photograph, NOT neon and NOT synthwave: one compact portable wireless speaker standing on a plain matte grey table against a plain flat mid-grey wall with nothing else in the picture. The speaker is a short upright cylinder wrapped in dark charcoal fabric mesh, with a matte black top carrying one thin ring light glowing soft magenta, and on its front a large perfectly round speaker cone with fine horizontal stripes. Three-quarter front view, soft neutral daylight. No grid, no sunset, no glow in the background.
speaker.is: the compact cylindrical wireless speaker in charcoal fabric with a glowing magenta ring on top and a large round striped speaker cone on its front
speaker.style: Style: a plain realistic photograph in neutral natural light, muted colours.

room.draw: An ordinary realistic photograph, NOT neon and NOT synthwave: a plain, dull small bedroom at dusk in flat grey-beige light. An unmade single bed with plain beige sheets, a bare wooden desk with a closed laptop, beige walls, and a window showing only flat overcast grey sky and a grey building. On the desk stands a compact cylindrical wireless speaker in charcoal fabric, switched off and dark. No coloured light anywhere, no pink, no purple, no glow.
room.is: the dull grey-beige bedroom at dusk with the small speaker standing switched off on the desk
room.style: Style: a plain realistic photograph in neutral natural light, muted colours.

sun.draw: A synthwave landscape: an endless glowing cyan laser grid floor running to a chrome horizon, black palm tree silhouettes on both sides, a magenta and purple sky with stars, and in the centre a huge perfectly round sunset sun in orange and magenta cut by fine dark horizontal stripes.
sun.is: the synthwave grid landscape with palm silhouettes and a huge round striped sunset sun

clips.sound: A silent dull room, a clock, then one soft electronic chime and a low synth bass note swelling.

shots.text: {room}, nothing moving, the grey light fading.
a close-up of {speaker} on the desk as the ring on its top blinks once and then glows steady magenta, the round cone on its front beginning to pulse.

rings of magenta and cyan light spreading out from the speaker across the desk and the floor, the bedroom floorboards turning into a glowing laser grid and the beige walls dissolving into a starry purple sky.

clips.sound: A driving synthwave beat, arpeggiated synthesizers, a sports car engine purring, wind rushing.

shots.text: the camera racing low over the grid floor of {sun}, neon lines streaking past, palm silhouettes flicking by on both sides.
a low wedge-shaped chrome sports car with glowing magenta tail lights speeding along a neon highway toward the horizon, reflections of the grid sliding over its body.
the chrome car cresting a hill and soaring off the end of the road into the sky straight toward the huge striped sun of {sun}, a trail of cyan light behind it.

clips.sound: The beat softening and echoing, a long shimmering synth chord, then the quiet of a room with music still playing softly.

shots.text: the huge round striped sun of {sun} filling the frame, its horizontal stripes pulsing gently in time like a speaker cone.
the camera pulling back and the striped sun turning out to be the round striped cone on the front of {speaker}, the neon sky shrinking into a glow around it.
{speaker} standing on the bedroom desk at night, its ring glowing magenta, the cone pulsing, and the whole dull room now washed in soft moving magenta and cyan light.
